user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with the maximum allowed guests (10) so that boundary values are handled correctly.

positive.title: Create booking with maximum allowed guests
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select 10 guests from the guest input option.
Fill in all required booking details (e.g., date, time, service).
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully created with 10 guests.

negative.title: Create booking with more than maximum allowed guests
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select 11 guests from the guest input option.
Fill in all required booking details (e.g., date, time, service).
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the maximum guest limit is 10.

edge.title: Create booking with no guests selected
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest.
Select 0 guests from the guest input option.
Fill in all required booking details (e.g., date, time, service).
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that at least one guest must be selected.
